parameters.content:
## 03 · Referral lifecycle
**Top:** dispatch. Two gates must pass — live `SHARE_WITH_*` consent, and clinician review where triage demanded it. Then match a facility, mint a scoped expiring share token, dispatch.

**Bottom:** the facility reports status back using that token. This is what makes referral completion and time-to-evaluation measurable.

Shared payload = risk summary only. Never raw answers, never free text.

assignments.name: vigorConfig
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = { agentServiceUrl: 'http://host.docker.internal:8000', internalToken: '', notifyMode: 'DEMO', oncallEmail: 'oncall@example-clinic.ae', escalationSlaMinutes: 60, quietHoursStart: 21, quietHoursEnd: 8, webhookBase: 'http://localhost:5678', envBlocked: true }; try { return { agentServiceUrl: $env.VIGOR_AGENT_SERVICE_URL || d.agentServiceUrl, internalToken: $env.VIGOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN || '', notifyMode: $env.VIGOR_NOTIFY_MODE || 'DEMO', oncallEmail: $env.VIGOR_ONCALL_EMAIL || d.oncallEmail, escalationSlaMinutes: Number($env.VIGOR_ESCALATION_SLA_MINUTES || 60), quietHoursStart: Number($env.VIGOR_QUIET_HOURS_START || 21), quietHoursEnd: Number($env.VIGOR_QUIET_HOURS_END || 8), webhookBase: ($env.WEBHOOK_URL || 'http://localhost:5678/').replace(/\/$/, ''), envBlocked: false }; } catch (e) { return d; } })() }}

nodes.name: Vigor config
nodes.notes: The only node that reads $env. Needs N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false, and falls back to defaults with envBlocked:true if that is missing.

nodes.name: Consent gate · SHARE
nodes.notes: The one gate that must never be bypassed. Its refusal is itself auditable.

nodes.name: Human-oversight gate
nodes.notes: A decision flagged for review cannot be dispatched until a clinician has signed it off. Workflow 09 releases it.

nodes.name: Select facility & mint token
nodes.notes: Preference matching is clinical access, not a nicety: language and the availability of a male clinician are real barriers for this cohort.

nodes.name: Build facility payload
nodes.notes: Minimisation in practice: bands and codes, no answer values, no free text, no contact details. The facility calls back with the token to get more.

nodes.name: Dispatch to facility
nodes.notes: In DEMO mode this is a stub endpoint; the referral row is the source of truth.

nodes.name: Webhook referral.status
nodes.notes: The facility authenticates with the share token it was given.

nodes.name: Authorise token
nodes.notes: Revoked or expired tokens are rejected here, which is what makes revocation real.
